analysis.title: Anthropic lifted but not the AI trade
key_insights: Anthropic, the first of the two major AI labs to list, opened at up to $115 (39% above the $83 introductory price), fell to $93, traded sideways and closed at $97, +17% on the day.
The debut did not produce the euphoria needed to support the AI trade. Nvidia, Alphabet, Amazon and Meta each fell just over 3%, the S&P 500 fell 2.0% and the Nasdaq fell 2.3%.
SEB asks whether market focus is shifting from AI hopes to a more traditional backdrop where the Fed's rate path matters more.
Asian equities fell sharply on AI-trade concern: Japan -4.9%, Korea -5.7%, Taiwan -6.6%. European and US futures point lower ahead of the open.
FX moves were muted, with a generally somewhat weaker dollar.

No major data is scheduled today. Europe has German producer prices and French business confidence. Sweden publishes labour market data, which SEB says has been volatile for over a year. SEB expects unemployment unchanged at 8.6%.
UK's Andy Burnham meets EU leaders in Brussels to finalize a new trade and cooperation agreement. SEB calls it a step in the right direction but far from the 'Breturn' some hope for.
